programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: Throughout history, there have been men of science who pushed the boundaries of experimentation to the edge of madness; they were renegades known for bizarre and often unethical experiments involving human-animal hybrids, mind control devices and even unimaginable torture; what led these mad scientists down a strange, dark path in their pursuit of knowledge?

programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: From demonic possession and cursed homes to battlefield apparitions and ancient pacts with the Devil, history is filled with chilling accounts of supernatural forces said to be working against humanity. Are these terrifying encounters simply the product of fear and belief... or could they point to a hidden war between good and evil-one that continues to this day?

programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: Throughout history, governments have carried out top secret projects that defy belief-from experimental aircraft and staged illusions to covert experiments that crossed ethical boundaries. Hidden from the public and revealed only years later, these operations raise a chilling question: if these programs were real... what else might still be happening in secret today?

programs.title: The UnXplained
programs.desc: People go missing every day, but throughout history, there have been strange and eerie disappearances that continue to capture the world's attention.

programs.title: The UnXplained
